text:
leah: Quick thread to lock down the Sapphire Systems customer story. Need checklist: interview, hero + expanded quote, legal clearance on perf numbers, gated benchmark PDF, and a 30/15 webinar the week after publish. Target publish: Thu next week. Can we land by Tue EOD?

tony: I can run the interview Mon 8:30am PT. Plan: capture deployment pain, what they changed, and the top 3 impact metrics.

reza: From infra: sanitized numbers show median latency down ~60% and p99 ~2.9x improvement after moving to Redwood routing + prefix cache. I'll export a redacted CSV and a short perf appendix.

mei: I'll draft two quote options. Hero needs to be short and punchy. Also need a 30-40 word blurb for the webinar page and a 1-line speaker bio.

ash: Sales ask: post-publish routing rule to send MQLs to enterprise-inbound@ and the AE rotation. Also tag source=sapphire in the handoff.

legal-bot: Reminder: no contract figures or raw user counts in public copy. Replace absolutes ("millions") with "large-scale production users" unless customer confirms. Upload NDA + interview consent to Drive and post viewer link here.

leah: Promo plan: announcement post + webinar invite + two reminders. promo-bot needs hero quote and speaker name to build the registration page.

reza: Perf appendix skeleton (sanitized) — I'll make sure to strip internal flags/dataset names:
```
# sanitized perf command
./rw_bench --model open-7b --seq 1024 --batch 8 --kv-cache --samples 1000 > bench.json
```
Legal: confirm ok to publish this skeleton once sanitized.

legal-bot: That skeleton is fine after you remove internal flags and any dataset references. Also do not publish pricing or contract terms. I'll review the transcript + CSV after upload; expect ~48h turnaround.

mei: Draft quotes: 
- hero: "Redwood made inference reliable and fast for our production traffic."
- long: "By switching to Redwood's routing and prefix caching we reduced median latency by ~60% and improved p99 nearly 3x, which let us ship low-latency features while lowering unit cost."

tony: I'll get verbatim approval for the hero during the call and capture a 1-line speaker bio. Also recording + consent link will be attached to the invite.

ash: Routing-bot  can you schedule a post-publish rule but keep it disabled until leah flips the switch? We need to test on staging first.

routing-bot: Scheduled routing rule (staging) for post-publish: enterprise-inbound@ + AE-rotation. Will run staging test after content is live on staging and report back.

promo-bot: Draft webinar page created at /campaigns/sapphire/webinar-staging. Will populate hero quote and speaker info once provided. Promo timeline: day-of publish email + 2 reminders.

leah: Checklist recap:
- interview scheduled (Tony)
- NDA + consent uploaded (Sapphire)
- hero + long quote captured and flagged (Mei)
- legal review on text + numbers (legal-bot)
- gated benchmark PDF prepared (Reza + Ops)
- post-publish routing tested (Routing-bot)
- webinar page + promo (Promo-bot)

reza: I'll upload redacted CSV to /mnt/benchmarks/sapphire/sapphire-redacted-2026.csv and a drafted gated PDF to /campaigns/sapphire/gated/sapphire-bench.pdf.

legal-bot: I'll aim to complete review by Tue 4pm PT once assets and transcript are uploaded. If anything needs rewording I'll flag it in this thread.

leah: Great. Checkpoint Tue EOD. If we have legal sign-off, ops-bot will flip publish and routing-bot will enable the handoff to sales. :thumbsup: Thanks everyone.

end of thread
